quest.title: Other Duties
quest.description: Semaine seems to be troubled by something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's send flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: We had the same line of thought! A bouquet of fragrant flowers will improve her mood for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: She likes three kinds of flowers. <color=#00E1FFFF>Rainbow Rose</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Romaritime Flower</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Lumidouce Bell</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Could you bring me a bunch of flowers, Traveler? Any of these three will do.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: I... can't leave at the moment. If she comes back around and finds me missing, I can forget about talking to her for the next two weeks.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: So please, help a man out, Traveler!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're a lot more motivated than when you're working.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Ah, but those are different matters! What is needed at the Maison Gestion is a stoic nature, but passion is a necessity when on a date with the one you love!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, yeah, okay... Gah, he's giving us that silly smile again...

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: I did order the flowers, but they will only arrive after the opera ends.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: And considering the current situation, it's up in the air whether she'll join me for that opera or not.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't we try sending perfume?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: That's what I was thinking too! Linorea's almost out of perfume, so this is a wonderful idea!

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: We often buy perfume from Calcagni in the city. If you would be so kind, Traveler, please help us go to her.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: I... can't leave at the moment. If she comes back around and finds me missing, I can forget about talking to her for the next two weeks.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're a lot more motivated than when you're working.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Ah, but those are different matters! What is needed at the Maison Gestion is a stoic nature, but passion is a necessity when on a date with the one you love!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay, okay.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: I left an advance payment with Calcagni, so you just need to go and pick the perfume up.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: But please hurry! We can't make Linorea wait for too long...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh boy, this guy's silly smile is back again...

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: We came to watch the opera, so even if we were going to purchase perfume, we'd have to get it after the performance, wouldn't you say?

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Anyway, who even sells perfume on Erinnyes? I mean... Anyway, I'm counting on you, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fish fry it is!

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Of course, my thoughts precisely! I was thinking of getting a new tank of fish fry for Linorea myself!

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Since job-related issues are troubling her, our encouragement should follow that same angle.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Please make a trip to the Court of Fontaine on my behalf. The man you're looking for is named Batasso, Linorea's colleague. He's certain to have some good fish fry on him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are you so sure? What if he doesn't have any?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I... In truth, I've been asking this gentleman to teach me how to rear fish, and I've bought lots of high-quality fry from him as well... Of course, Linorea knows nothing about this.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, let me mark this location for you. Batasso tends to show up there.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Well, she is just so lovable...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Let's go get the fry, {NICKNAME}. He can smile here all he wants!

choices.text: You're hopelessly in love with her, aren't you...

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: This is... a Rainbow Rose.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Sorry, Semaine. I was so preoccupied with taking Damestier on, that I forgot to care for that Rainbow Rose at home.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that this one, too, will...

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Linorea. Go and do what you must. I promise that flowers that do not wilt will always be waiting for you at home.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Oh, Semaine...

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Why are you giving me Romaritime Flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I usually send you Rainbow Roses, but I thought that we should have a change of pace today.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I see, is that so... Why do I feel like you're telling me to calm down?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: That is exactly the case, dear Linorea. Could you please do so? The opera is about to begin.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Ah, alright, since you went to the trouble with these flowers... But you must stay with me, always. Someone has to make sure I remain calm, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Your wish is my command, milady. Not a step away shall I take.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Hmph. Ah, dear, dear Semaine... A Lumidouce Bell, as a gift? Is this a threat? To break things off with me if I do not calm myself?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Ah, come now, I would never imply such a thing. I just wish that your heart might be freed from these frustrations as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: The opera is about to begin. If your heart remains within their terrible grip, I fear we won't be able to enter the hall.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Alright, alright. I'll do my best to put it out of my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Hmm... Which opera should we watch this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go with Marcotte.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Alright. Please wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go with Lakelight.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Alright. Please wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go with Tidalga.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Alright. Please wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Traveler, thank goodness you're here. Did you get the fish fry?

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Hah! This is exactly the perfume I need. Thank you, Semaine.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I shall wear this perfume to go and interview that fool Damestier. I'll corner her with ease this time, just you see!

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Hahaha. I love it when you're so full of vigor, Linorea.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: But before you ride off to war, let's hurry and get to the opera house first, or we'll miss the opening for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Right you are! Let's enjoy the opera first. Then I'll collect my thoughts and crush that Damestier once and for all!

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: This perfume... Dear Semaine, are you reminding me to focus my attention on you?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: You could focus on the opera too... I just wish you wouldn't let all the Mekafish business ruin the wonderful time we spend together.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: ...Well, as you wish, my dear.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: The scent of algae... Heh, this certainly brings the fish tank back to mind.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: I entrust you with everything while I go toe-to-toe with Damestier, dear Semaine.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: To attend to your ideals is my great honor, milady.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: *sigh* I find it hard to conceive of how a good fellow like you survives in an environment as idiotic as the Maison Gestion...

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I have a conscience, a sense of humor, and two excellent colleagues.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: And of course, I have you, milady, my constant companion.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: My, what a talker! Do you speak even half this much at the Maison Gestion?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I barely speak at all while I'm there. Words do my work no good.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Alright, dear Linorea. The opera is about to begin, so let us be off.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: As you say, my love. I shall do as you say.

dialogues.speaker: Batasso
dialogues.text: Ah, Linorea... I fear your temper must itself be tempered...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Linorea's fish fry...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You state your reasons for being here...

dialogues.speaker: Batasso
dialogues.text: Semaine is... Well, his love for Linorea knows no worldly equal, I'll say that much.

dialogues.speaker: Batasso
dialogues.text: Here, take these fry with you. Semaine requested that I find them... Plans to send them to her as a gift, I'll bet.

dialogues.speaker: Batasso
dialogues.text: Alright, take the fry to Semaine, would you? I've got some other things to handle.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Thank you so much! This is a most lovely flower. It shall go to her right this instant!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's just watch from over here. If we get too close, things might get kinda...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Awkward.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. Anyway, let's just hope Linorea does cheer up, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Batasso is reliable, as always. Linorea will surely love these fish fry.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I'll pass it to her right this instant!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's just watch from over here. If we get too close, things might get kinda...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Awkward.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. Anyway, let's just hope Linorea does cheer up, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Where... did you get these fish fry?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Hmm, didn't you tell me before that you wanted to investigate the fry in that particular body of water?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: That's why I asked a good friend of mine to collect some. I treated him to quite a few meals on that account.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: But when did I... Ah! Was that the day when we went boating... But I only said it in passing...

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Ah, don't underestimate the memory of a Gestionnaire, milady.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Semaine...

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Alright. Let's admire this tank of fish fry later. For now, let us go into the opera house. The show is about to begin.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Ah, I daresay that we are the only ones in the Court of Fontaine who would bring a fish tank to an opera.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: And that's a good thing. It makes us unique.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Indeed, my dear lady. In that case, let us be off.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: As you say, Semaine.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Welcome. Are you here to purchase some perfume? We've just got some new stock.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here about Linorea's perfume...

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean Ms. Linorea? She comes around often to buy "Marcotte" perfume.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: According to her, she will only put it on when she goes out on official business.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken, however, Mr. Semaine, who comes with her, prefers "Lakelight."

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Perhaps he favors gentler scents...

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Ah, yes! We did promote some "Tidalga" perfume previously. It has a unique algae scent. I do recall Ms. Linorea taking quite the interest in it.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Semaine has already given us the Mora beforehand, so just take your pick, and I'll hand you the perfume of your choice.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: What made her angry this time...

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Traveler? Why, fancy meeting you here. How may I be of service? It would be my honor to...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Please get to the point.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Ah. Sorry. I've been doing a lot of writing lately, so all these descriptors just came tumbling right out of my mouth.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: *sigh* Don't even talk about it. I was preparing to go to the opera with Linorea, but before we could head out, she suddenly received a letter from her colleague.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: She continued to read as we walked, and she'd finished it by the time we reached the opera house. After that...

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: ...And then she fell into a terrible sulk, writing furiously in her notebook. She was inconsolable...

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Oh, right, by the way, she's my girlfriend.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: If not for the situation that arose today, she would have been most happy to meet you two...

choices.text: You sound quite used to this.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: We've been together for so long... I've long gotten used to her temper.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: I usually get her a present whenever she's upset — all to divert her attention to the good things, you know?

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Better that than to let her stew. That's not good for her health.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Traveler, could you help me pick the gift this time?

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Oh, don't worry about it. I always pick things she likes. You don't need to worry about ruining her mood or anything.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: I just need a second opinion from outside. Y'know, for perspective.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: See, I usually send either flowers or perfumes.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: So please, help me make the final decision.

choices.text: I'm not good at stuff like this.
Do you know why she's angry?

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: *sigh* What else can it be, if not that Mekafish business? She always gets so worked up about environmental protection.

choices.text: You're... that guy from the Maison Gestion...

response.text: Didn't think we'd see her here as well...

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: See, I usually send either flowers or perfumes... or fish fry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, who sends their girlfriend fish fry!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know, Linorea might actually be the type to like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? Well, when we last met Linorea, she really was distributing fish fry...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But would anyone take that stuff as a present?

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Oh, she loves them! She's always discussing them with her friends, talking about things like "breeding" and other matters I don't really understand.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: We also have a large number of fish tanks in our house, filled with the fry she's raised.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What a unique person.

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: Yes, I find this side of her most lovable as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look at this guy smile! It's like he's a different person from the one we see at the Maison Gestion...

response.speaker: Semaine
response.text: *cough* Heh. Well, in any case, please help me decide.

choices.text: I'm not good at stuff like this.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: What made her angry this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here this time?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Linorea has been enraged by that Damestier... again.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: A few days back, Linorea and a few of her colleagues went to see that lady and asked her to give some clear answers about the Mekafish.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: But she was all "I can't do anything. There's no point pestering me," as usual. Linorea was forced to go back empty-handed.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I wanted to invite her to go see an opera today and take her mind off these matters, but alas, she caught sight of the fish in the fountain and was once again reminded of her troubles.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: And she... Well, she started sulking again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not to be rude or anything, but she sure does get angry easily...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She really cares about her work.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: More precisely, she really cares about her ideals. That's why she's such a brilliant journalist.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But she's always so mad. Do you...

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Yes, I find this side of her most lovable as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, cut it out, or your smile might split your face open!

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Ahem! ... Well, please help me make my final decision, just like the last time! Please!

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Fontaine Research Institute... You shall not escape punishment!

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Curses... If only she'd reply. Then I'd have time to take care of those <color=#00E1FFFF>Rainbow Roses</color> we have at home.

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Next time, I'll make sure I wear some <color=#00E1FFFF>Marcotte perfume</color> before speaking to her!

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: *sigh* I even need Semaine's help to care for the fish at home... and he's invited me to the opera...

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: But will I really make a satisfactory date for him the way I am now...?

dialogues.speaker: Linorea
dialogues.text: Fontaine Research Institute... Just you wait!

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Have you brought Linorea's flowers? She likes three kinds, <color=#00E1FFFF>Rainbow Rose</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Romaritime Flower</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Lumidouce Bell</color>. Any of them will do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Thank you so much! Just bring them straight back to me once you find them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Already done.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: In that case, give me the flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, thank goodness you're back. Have you the perfume with you?

dialogues.speaker: Player

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Please, then. I'm counting on you.

dialogues.text: Ah, in that case, pass me the perfume.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Ah. In that case, please give them to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you just staring into space over here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, aren't you gonna go console her? Don't upset people usually want someone by their side who'll hear what they have to say?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Linorea's different. She prefers to be alone at such times, because... she tends to say some... extreme things to herself in the heat of the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I've tried to do so a few times, but she insists that I stay at the side, claiming "I don't want you to see me like this."

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: What could I do — if not only as she asked?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Iaune...

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: He's a good kid, diligent, earnest, and loyal.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: He's just going through a period of confusion that everyone's also been through. Once he gets through it and clears up what his ideals really are, he'll be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Roialte and I will both help him out. I mean, he's one of us here at the office, isn't he?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me consider further...

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Once you have decided on the perfume you want, just tell me straight.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Which type of perfume would you like, dear customer?

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: Excellent — this perfume smells phenomenal! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: I'll pass it to her right this instant!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look at this guy smile! It's like he's a different person from the one we see at the Maison Gestion...

dialogues.speaker: Semaine
dialogues.text: *cough* Heh. Well, in any case, please help me decide.
